items.text: Merrill runs an Advisor Development Program to train new financial advisors, with roles designed to help participants identify client financial goals, align banking and investing solutions, and build a book of high-net-worth clients.
items.quote: If you're interested in a career in wealth management and possess the entrepreneurial spirit - the Advisor Development Program is for you. Roles are designed to enhance your ability to meet and help clients identify financial goals, align banking and investing solutions and build your book of high-net worth clients.

items.text: Advisor Development Program participants progress through three roles (Client Associate, Financial Solutions Advisor, and Financial Advisor) before graduating to Merrill Core Advisor, with the Financial Advisor role lasting approximately 1-4 years.
items.quote: After mastering key objectives and pre-determined targets, progress through three roles until you graduate to Merrill Core Advisor.

items.text: Merrill is recruiting experienced advisors, but its primary strategy is a training program that trains people in wealth management at Bank of America and Merrill, which management believes drives improved net new flows.
items.quote: we're picking up the recruiting of experienced advisors. That isn't an enormous part of our strategy, but it's a training program so that we're training people in wealth management, Bank of America, and Merrill, and that's ultimately what we believe we can just keep driving in order to improve the net new flows.

items.text: Approximately one-third of net new households added in Q2 2025 were added by Merrill's newly trained advisors.
items.quote: Approximately one-third of net new households in Q2 were added by our newly trained advisors.

items.text: Merrill's management aims to keep growing the sales force, and advisor attrition is now at near historic lows.
items.quote: just keep growing the sales force. Well, adviser attrition is now at near historic lows.

items.text: Merrill continues to attract talent across both new and experienced advisers, driving productivity higher on both newer and existing members of its financial advisers team.
items.quote: We're driving productivity higher on both newer and existing members of our financial advisers team, and we continue to attract talent across both new and experienced advisers.

items.text: Merrill (across GWIM and Consumer Banking wealth management businesses) had 18,916 total wealth advisors at the end of 2023, down from 19,273 at the end of 2022.
items.scope: Includes advisors across all wealth management businesses in GWIM and Consumer Banking

items.text: Merrill and the Private Bank have more than 15,000 wealth advisors.
Merrill had 446 advisors named to the 2025 Forbes 'Top Next-Generation Wealth Advisors Best-in-State' list, more than any other firm.
